text.en:
4th. MARCH, 2020 No. S 12

TRADE MARKS ACT (Chapter 98) Notification of commencement In exercise of the power conferred by section l(3.) of the Trade Marks Act, the Attorney General, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, hereby appoints 1st June 2000 as the date on which sections 75, 76, 77, 78, 79, 80 and 81 of that Act shall be deemed to have commenced. Dated this 8th. day of Rejab, 1441 Hijriah corresponding to the 3rd. day of March, 2020.

DATO SERI PADUKA AWANG HAJI HAIROL ARNI BIN HAJI ABDUL MAJID Attorney General.
